title: AVM HUB
features:
Description
Auto TP Random + Drop – Automatically teleports to random nukes in your base and drops them to merge.

Cycle Delay – Adjusts how quickly the auto-merge cycle runs.

Auto Request Lock – Automatically requests to lock your base.

Auto Purchase Lock – Automatically purchases the Lock Base upgrade when available.

Auto Purchase Tier – Automatically buys the next available Nuke Tier upgrade.

Auto Purchase Max – Automatically purchases the Max upgrade for your base.

Run Speed – Increases your movement speed with an adjustable slider.

High Jump – Boosts your jump height for easier navigation.

Infinite Jump – Allows unlimited mid-air jumps.

Smart ESP – Highlights nukes in your base with bright outlines for easy visibility through walls.
